newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Hartmann-euro debt conversion being studied.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Hartmann-euro debt conversion being studied.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Wendelin Hartmann said on Monday that the possibility of converting outstanding German government debt to euros in 1999 was being intensively considered.

"Intensive studies are being carried out at the moment to determine whether public paper currently in circulation, at least that which has a benchmark function, should immediately be denominated in euro in order to avoid the market being divided," Hartmann said.
A text of his speech was released in Frankfurt in advance of delivery to a bank conference in Munich.
France has put Germany under some pressure by pledging to convert all its debt issues -- both new and outstanding -- into euros from the currency's launch in 1999.
